summary: Example showing that a loop item set to `{{ omit }}` now leaves the key undefined, and the task should use `item.msg | default(omit)` instead.
questions: Why is item.msg undefined when I set it to omit in the loop?
How do I pass omit from a loop item to a module argument?

answer_card.title: Use default(omit) for omitted loop item keys
answer_card.answer_md:
The loop item key set to `{{ omit }}` is now removed, so `item.msg` is undefined:

```yaml
- debug:
    msg: "{{ item.msg }}"  # 'msg' is undefined
  loop:
   - msg: "{{ omit }}"
```

Add `default(omit)` on the task side:

```yaml
- debug:
    msg: "{{ item.msg | default(omit) }}"
  loop:
   - msg: "{{ omit }}"
```
